description: Reject an invalid property-graph definition with a categorized error. A vertex or edge table that names a non-existent base table is rejected; an edge whose key references a vertex table not listed in the definition is rejected; repeating the same label within one definition is rejected; and syntactically illegal definition text (such as a wildcard property list) is rejected at parse time. Each failure is reported as a neutral category plus the engine's explanatory message.

setup: CREATE TABLE Student(id BIGINT, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO Student VALUES (0,'Daniel'),(1,'Tavneet'),(2,'Gabor'),(3,'Peter')
CREATE TABLE know(src BIGINT, dst BIGINT, createDate BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE School(school_name VARCHAR, school_id BIGINT, school_kind BIGINT)
INSERT INTO School VALUES ('VU',0,0),('UVA',1,1)
input.query: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgx VERTEX TABLES (tabledoesnotexist)

setup: CREATE TABLE Student(id BIGINT, name VARCHAR)

input.query: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgx VERTEX TABLES (Student) EDGE TABLES (edgetabledoesnotexist SOURCE KEY (id) REFERENCES Student (id) DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES Student (id))

input.query: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgx VERTEX TABLES (Student PROPERTIES ( * ) LABEL Person)

setup: CREATE TABLE Student(id BIGINT, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO Student VALUES (0,'Daniel'),(1,'Tavneet'),(2,'Gabor'),(3,'Peter')
CREATE TABLE know(src BIGINT, dst BIGINT, createDate BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE School(school_name VARCHAR, school_id BIGINT, school_kind BIGINT)
INSERT INTO School VALUES ('VU',0,0),('UVA',1,1)
input.query: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgx VERTEX TABLES (Student PROPERTIES (id,name) LABEL Person, School AS school_alias PROPERTIES (school_id,school_name) LABEL School IN School_kind (University, Hogeschool, University)) EDGE TABLES (know SOURCE KEY (src) REFERENCES Student (id) DESTINATION KEY (dst) REFERENCES Student (id) PROPERTIES (createDate) LABEL Knows)

cases.expected_output:
error=constraint
message=Label university is not unique, make sure all labels are unique
